## Open

### F-338 — A reorder inside the screenshot tolerance keeps a stale baseline green

> _2026-10-01 · realm/blong-commander · open_

Updating the commander explore baselines took several wrong turns. The shared Playwright config
allows maxDiffPixelRatio 0.01, so swapping two nodes in the navigator is inside the tolerance: the
shot neither fails nor gets rewritten, so npm run playwright:update silently leaves the stale
baseline in place and the test only fails in CI, where the same reorder also moved the table. A
throwaway config that sets expect.toHaveScreenshot.maxDiffPixelRatio to 0 is what makes the real
diffs visible; with it, only explore-k8s-categories, explore-redis-keys, explore-k8s-pods,
explore-k8s-pod and explore-keycloak-users differ, and explore-vault-mounts fails on a pre-existing
whole-page 1px shift that a git stash of the fix reproduces unchanged. Second trap: blong-watch did
not re-load branchList.ts after a git stash push and pop, so the next playwright --update-snapshots
re-baked the unsorted render over the freshly written baseline. Confirm what the shot depends on
before regenerating it — commander.branch/list through blong-dev proxy shows the order the navigator
will get — and restart the backend when a file was rewritten by git.

## Resolved

### F-091 — Commander grew to 18k px because flex children could not shrink

> _2026-07-09 · realm/blong-commander · resolved_

After the Splitter was added, Commander grew to ~18k px with a tall table (573 MySQL rows). The
`height: 100%` chain resolved against content because `.p-tabview` in Portal.css had `flex-grow: 1`
but no `min-height: 0`: flex `min-height: auto` blocked shrinking below content, so the tabview, the
tab panel, `.commander-page` and Commander all grew to the table's height. The inner tree/content
divs inside `SplitterPanel` collapsed to content width as well, because panels are
`display: flex; flex-direction: row`.

About 25 minutes went into measuring ancestor heights with `getBoundingClientRect` walks; the root
cause was the missing `min-height: 0` plus a missing `flex: 1` on the panel children. Fixed in
Portal.css, commanderBrowsePage and the Commander splitter styles.

### F-092 — `{parent.X}` leaf-open templates resolved to empty and 404'd

> _2026-08-23 · realm/blong-commander · resolved_

`commander.node.get` only received the leaf node, so `{parent.path}` (vault) resolved to empty and
the request failed with 404 'Vault Secret Not Found'; S3's `{parent.bucket}` only worked because the
adapter fell back to a default bucket. The parent's fields were not carried to the leaf. The fix
stamps the direct parent's fields as `parent.<field>` on every row (`withParentContext`). Cost about
20 minutes across vault/S3/mongo/k8s.

### F-093 — PrimeReact DataTable kept stale body rows after a table switch

> _2026-08-23 · realm/blong-commander · resolved_

After switching from a table with 200+ rows to a small one, the DOM still showed the old rows while
the React state was already correct ('keeps showing db data while changing columns'). It took ~15
minutes of fiber-tree inspection (`__reactFiber$` state) to confirm that rows state was right and
only the DOM was stale.

Fix: remount the DataTable per navigation with `key={selected.key}` plus a `loadTokenRef` race
guard.
